project.name: fiu
project.description: Fiu is a CLI that keeps developers fluent in code they (or AI agents) did not write, by turning real repository code into small, verified practice Workouts (Drills, Katas, Predictions, What-ifs, Diagnoses), organising them into Tracks, mapping the repository in an Atlas, and tracking comprehension debt.

nodes.name: Background Generation
nodes.summary: Practises new code automatically: a post-commit hook runs `fiu refill`, which turns each commit into a Quick Workout under a per-repository lock, queue and daily caps, and logs every outcome.

businessRules: Enabling background generation requires consent to send code to the provider.
Default caps: queue cap 3, daily limit 5 generations, expiry 14 days, aiOnly off.
Only one generator runs per repository (lock file); further commits are queued in a backlog of 5.
Merge commits, commits made during a merge/rebase/cherry-pick/revert, commits by another author, and (with aiOnly) non-AI commits are skipped.
At most one drillable file per commit is chosen: the recognised source file with the most changed lines.
Background Workouts that sit in the queue past their expiry are discarded.
The hook installer only edits Fiu's marked block and never touches the user's own hook lines.
crossDomainInteractions: Fills the Quick queue consumed by Training & Practice.

nodes.name: Refill the Queue from a Commit
nodes.summary: On each commit the hook runs `fiu refill --background`, which turns the commit into a Quick Workout while enforcing locks, skip rules and caps, and logs the outcome.

nodes.name: Expire stale Workouts
nodes.summary: Discards background Workouts that sat in the queue past their expiry.

nodes.name: Acquire the repository lock
nodes.summary: Takes the per-repo lock, taking over dead or hung holders; otherwise queues the commit in the backlog.

nodes.name: Read and screen the commit
nodes.summary: Reads the commit, detects AI co-authorship, and skips merges, in-progress operations and other authors.

nodes.name: Choose the target file
nodes.summary: Picks at most one drillable file: the recognised source file with the most changed lines.

nodes.name: Enforce queue and daily caps
nodes.summary: Defers when the queue cap is reached or today's generation limit is used up.

nodes.name: Generate a Quick Workout
nodes.summary: Generates, verifies and saves the Workout through the shared pipeline.

nodes.name: Log the outcome
nodes.summary: Appends the commit's outcome to the JSON-lines log for later failure summaries.
